author: Polycarpus von Schneidau (underlying daguerreotype, attributed by the 1881 caption); wood engraver unestablished
date: 1881 (contained cut inspected; first separate appearance not established)

rights_note: The actual 1881 United States publication is public domain by age. These bytes were independently acquired from its Internet Archive scan; no agency, auction or check_required modern reproduction is substituted.

note: The caption names several ranges spatially; the unique cupola blockhouse identifies securely. The gallery, tall gable and stack ordering closely parallels Kurz panel 5. The Marine Hospital, board fence and enlarged parade remain the later 1850 state. Diagnostic cameras render July 1835 models with the actual depiction dates stated.
